source.stem:
A person measures the length, width, height and mass of a metal block with rectangular sides.
Which of these measurements must be used in order to calculate the density of the metal?

intelligence.enrichment: Materials attracted towards a magnet are magnetic materials; materials not attracted towards a magnet are non-magnetic materials. Iron, nickel, cobalt, and some of their combinations with other metals are magnetic. material response to a nearby magnet determines magnetic or non-magnetic classification The learner classifies an object as magnetic only when it is attracted towards the magnet, and identifies iron, nickel, cobalt, and some of their combinations as magnetic materials. Anything that looks hard or metallic should stick to a magnet, and anything soft should not.
